# Anchor

![Anchor](https://scholzdev.github.io/tossup/img/coins/anchor.png)

Heads: 2 points, and the next time the combo would break it holds instead.

- **Rarity:** Uncommon
- **Heads chance:** 50%
- **Shop price:** 15 gold
- **Energy to flip:** 0

## Heads
Score 2 points, The next combo break is prevented

## Tails
Score 1 point

## Who can use it
- **Starts in the deck of:** none
- **Usable in coin sets from the start:** none
- **Found in the shop and unlocked by buying it once:** [The Seer](characters-seer), [The Trader](characters-trader)
